items.title: Why Is American Tower (AMT) Adding A New Board Voice On Talent And Governance?
items.summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) appointed Kristen M. Ludgate to its Board of Directors and its Compensation and Human Capital Committee. Ludgate previously served as Chief People Officer at HP Inc. and held senior leadership roles at 3M. She also brings board experience from companies in the banking and technology sectors. The addition of Kristen M. Ludgate to American Tower's board only partially reflects how the business is evolving. We have also spotted 1 major warning sign worth knowing about...

items.title: Can Dell's Margins Catch Up With Its Stock?
items.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock has returned 341% over the past twelve months, the best record among the six companies in its peer group. Its revenue growth also ranks first. Its operating margin ranks only fourth, and that gap is what a buyer today has to judge. Behind the growth is demand for its servers that has outrun its own supply.

items.title: HP Stock Drops After PC Maker Forecasts Industry Sales Decline
items.summary: HPQ stock fell Monday after HP forecast industrywide personal computer sales will decline by mid-single digits next year.

items.title: Is Apple Stock's Shrinking Share Count Worth Paying Up For Near The Highs?
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock has gained 41.2% over the past twelve months and trades near its 52-week high of $339.79. All the while, Apple keeps buying back its own shares, so each share you hold claims a bigger slice of the profit. That engine is real and well funded, but at 38.2 times trailing earnings it explains only a small part of what you are now paying for.

items.title: HP Inc. Warns of Extended PC Market Slump. The Stock Is Tumbling.
items.summary: HP Inc. says it expects personal computer unit volumes to fall by a mid-single-digit percentage point in 2027 as costs continue to rise.

items.title: HP’s Unit And Margin Pressures Not Factored-In By The Stock’s Multi-Year Valuation Highs, Says Morgan Stanley
